key_insight: Hybrid-DFT calculations identify Mn substitution at Zn sites in MOF-5 as a promising route to bifunctional oxygen reduction and evolution catalysis.
engineering_relevance: Tuning dopant-derived electronic states could guide the design of MOF-based oxygen electrocatalysts using non-precious metals.
method: Model nine transition-metal substitutions at Zn sites using hybrid DFT.
Analyze stability, electronic states, magnetism, and interactions with oxygenated intermediates.
Evaluate ORR and OER activity using the computational hydrogen electrode model.
evidence_signal: Calculated ORR overpotentials are 0.57 V for Mn and Fe substitutions; OER overpotentials are 0.42 V for Mn and 0.51 V for Co substitutions.
watch_item: The predicted activity requires experimental validation, including confirmation of dopant incorporation and framework stability under operating conditions.
paper_title: Transition-Metal Substitutions in MOF-5: A Hybrid-DFT Study of Oxygen Electrocatalysis
